_about: The source registry. Every outbound 'official source' link, every monitor target and every attribution on the site resolves to an entry here by id; URLs are never hard-coded in templates. reliability follows the site's source hierarchy: official (Tier 1) > reliable_news (Tier 2) > business_official (Tier 3) > social (Tier 4, never confirmation). urlStatus: 'located' = the URL was returned by a search of the official domain but has not been opened by an editor; 'unchecked' = listed from editorial knowledge; 'to_be_confirmed' = no URL yet (the entry is inactive until one is added). tools/monitor-sources.py records live reachability in data/state/source-state.json, never here.
